title: Cyrus and the Asset
author: Petra Dunmore
blurb: August Nystrom, an interpreter attached to a peace delegation destined to fail, hasn't slept through the night since the incident. But when a voiceprint unlocks a server on another continent, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must trade the one secret worth killing for, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
